detail.longDescription: One day I wondered about problems between my # Matrix server and # Element desktop client. It turned out Synapse was terminated by OOM killer... and it wasn't last time that happened. Now I just started service again, without big hope it would be running long. I feel after enabling federation I finally reach that wall where lowest tier VPS just cannot bear all my services running there on minimal resources - which worked by some supernatural miracle for 7 years. I started thinking about migrating anyway because of other reasons, but now I have more dilemma. If I have to move everything and start from scratch, it maybe could be better to use physical machine (even if not big, heavy, energy-hungry industrial server) and buy local Hackerspace network and server room storage. But now prices of any hardware are insane because of this slop hype... I don't know what to do and I don't like it. # selfhosting # selfhosted # server # VPS
